description: Trigger a Grok-AI gemological appraisal of a single gem on GemHunt (https://gemhunt.app — Father's gem-discovery platform). Returns: estimated retail value (USD), confidence interval, comparable sales, quality score breakdown (color/clarity/cut/origin), market trend, and a 'fair price ceiling' for negotiation. Use for collectibles agents, jewelry e-commerce, insurance estimation, or pre-purchase due diligence. Premium ($0.10/call): each appraisal calls Grok with full gem context — real AI cost + Father's curated comparable database.
name: alya_gem_appraise
